program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (pt< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (normalize cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first bb))
             (c0 (second bb)))
        (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) cells) pt<)))
    (define a (normalize (find-color g 2)))
    (define b (normalize (find-color g 3)))
    (define allc (remove-duplicates (append a b)))
    (define out-h (+ 1 (apply max (map first allc))))
    (define out-w (+ 1 (apply max (map second allc))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)]) ([p (in-list allc)])
      (cond [(and (member p a) (member p b)) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8)]
            [(member p a) (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 2)]
            [else (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 3)]))))
